resources.string: Security alerts
A control agent\'s key was used from a new device or network
Security
Lock control agents to their device
Each control agent\'s key works only from the Tailscale device that first used it. Another device is refused and you\'re asked.
Alert on new devices and networks
A notification when a control agent shows up from somewhere new, with one tap to block it
Confirm with fingerprint
Turning on Super Powers, approving control agent requests and allowing a new device need your fingerprint, face or screen lock
Relay: signed requests only
Relay control agents that can control the phone must use sealed mode, signed with their own key. Portals still work; sign-in connectors (like claude.ai) stop.
How Bridgit keeps control agents in check
